test_title: PYST 11: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Town Q is to the east of Town P. Town R is to the south of Town Q. Town S is to the east of Town R. Town T is to the south of Town S. Town U is to the east of Town T. What is the position of Town U with respect to Town Q?
solution:
Given: 

Town Q is to the east of Town P.

Town R is to the south of Town Q.

Town S is to the east of Town R.

Town T is to the south of Town S.

Town U is to the east of Town T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/053f32327407f0b5ecdfd463816d3acbddc02fc720f75bd56b98a5f86325e45b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2059e98f678a16d3ef2c7d7a1c1c26bf5538c29dbcbaf82c83faf9f72e7a0c07.png] 

Q is at the top-left region.

U is diagonally down to the right of Q (toward the south-east).

So, Town U is to the South-East of Town Q.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
